recommendations.description: Launch a CT Commercial Individual PPO acute-hospital inpatient policy review for PA-required admissions to assess initial and concurrent review KPIs, confirm prior authorization and denial enforcement, validate auth-to-claim matching, perform itemized bill review, and verify contractual claims processing for Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC and Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC.
evidence: CT PPO PA-required acute hospitals added about $42.0M.
Admissions increased by 682 and paid per admit increased about $3.4K.
Craniotomy cases added about $1.5M with higher paid per admit.
Chemotherapy cases added about $0.3M with higher paid per admit.

recommendations.description: Run a NY Commercial Individual HMO PA-required acute hospital admission audit to confirm prior authorization was obtained, enforce auth-to-claim matching and denial processing, review CUMG nurse and MD approval and referral decisions, and identify diagnosis/service cohorts for outpatient site-of-care redirection.
evidence: NY HMO acute hospitals added about $17.3M.
Admissions increased by 464 while paid per admit decreased about $21.0K.
PA-required HMO acute hospital claims drove most pressure.
Business terms include auth-to-claim validation, site-of-care, and utilization.
peer_benchmarking: Emblem Health summary is off-topic and offers no comparable NY acute inpatient benchmark.

recommendations.description: Perform a CO case-level authorization and payment compliance review for PA-required Commercial Individual HMO acute-hospital Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC linked to BENIGN NEOPLASM CEREBRAL MENINGES, SECONDARY MALIGNANT NEOPLASM BRAIN, and CEREBRAL ANEURYSM NONRUPTURED; validate denial enforcement, auth-to-claim matching, reimbursement methodology, and provider/facility contract remediation.
evidence: PA-required HMO acute-hospital neuro cases drove the CO inpatient increase.
Craniotomy and endovascular intracranial procedures with MCC concentrated spend in CO.
Admissions rose in CO Commercial Individual HMO acute hospitals.
BENIGN NEOPLASM CEREBRAL MENINGES and SECONDARY MALIGNANT NEOPLASM BRAIN reinforced the pattern.
CEREBRAL ANEURYSM NONRUPTURED appeared as a new or rare high-cost case.
Operational cards flag auth-to-claim validation, site-of-care, unit cost, and utilization.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles applicable neuro services with 69990 or 64727.
United Health limits billing to allowed neurolysis or nervous system surgery companions.

recommendations.description: Pause UM or contract changes and complete a claims-processing audit that reconciles authorization denial enforcement, manual adjudication edits, and facility assignment for AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and Not Mapped inpatient claims in CA, WI, NY, CT, and IN, focused on CPMC VAN NESS CAMPUS, AURORA ST. LUKE'S MEDICAL CENTER, AURORA MEDICAL CENTER - SHEBOYGAN COUNTY, and LENOX HILL HOSPITAL, then rerun the impacted views.
evidence: CA AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION added about $5.0M and requires validation before action.
WI chemotherapy AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION added about $1.2M at AURORA ST. LUKE'S.
NY HMO Not Mapped claims added about $1.1M on 40 more admissions.
CT and CA Not Mapped buckets added about $0.9M; IN added about $37K.

recommendations.description: Require UM review of discharge destinations for Commercial Individual orthopedic aftercare cases tied to Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC and ENC FOR OTHER ORTHOPEDIC AFTERCARE before step-down to Physical Rehab, LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL, CHILDRENS, or ACUTE PSYCH in CA, NY, and CT; audit authorization-to-claim matching, enforce denied authorizations, review nonrequired or overridden authorizations, and verify specialty facility claims adjudicate per contract.
evidence: Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC is a key driver.
ENC FOR OTHER ORTHOPEDIC AFTERCARE is a focused CA clinical pattern.
NY HMO Physical Rehab added about $0.5M with higher paid per admit.
CA EPO Physical Rehab added about $0.5M on 10 more admissions.
CT PPO long-term care hospital increase was volume-led.
Auth dimension present across key Physical Rehab and specialty facility cards.

recommendations.description: Perform a provider-specific inpatient chemotherapy policy audit for Aurora St. Luke's Medical Center in WI and CA Commercial Individual EPO acute hospital claims: verify PA-to-claim matching and inpatient bundling or contract edits for ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO, and redirect eligible treatment to outpatient oncology settings.
evidence: WI PA-required HMO inpatient chemotherapy concentrated at Aurora St. Luke's Medical Center.
CA Commercial Individual EPO acute hospital claims carried auth_dimension_present flag.
Diagnosis isolated to ENCOUNTER FOR ANTINEOPLASTIC CHEMO.
Service focused on Chemotherapy without Acute Leukemia as Secondary Diagnosis with CC.
peer_benchmarking: Cigna limits separate reimbursement in inpatient facilities; office reimbursement allowed and home infusion needs precertification.
United Health bundles chemotherapy administration into inpatient hospital charges without separate reimbursement.
Elevance bundles same-day facility chemotherapy items into facility fees and restricts facility billing.
